ASSESSMENT

Diagnosis: Poor appetite in diabetic dog after insulin dose increase

Differential Diagnosis: Possible insulin overdose or side effects causing anorexia; other causes of poor appetite in diabetic dogs including concurrent illness or stress

PLAN

Treatment Plan and Recommendations: - Started Entyce 3 mg/kg PO once daily for appetite stimulation - Continue Veticulin insulin at 14 units twice daily - Recheck fructosamine in two weeks to assess diabetic control

Follow-up: Recheck fructosamine in two weeks
